Subject: SOC 2 & audit evidence — post-call recap and next steps

Hi Alice — great to meet you and Maya today. Thanks for the time. Below is a short recap of the items we discussed, the pain you called out, and the next steps so your procurement and security teams have everything in one place.

Summary of call (high level)
- Use case: Acme Health wants to run clinical document summarization and patient-facing chat; strict audit and retention requirements due to PHI concern.
- Pain points: need clear evidence of SOC 2 controls (security & availability), access to audit logs (retention, format), DPA / data residency language, and pen-test results or summary.
- Goals: meet Acme procurement timeline (SOW by mid-March), confirm DPA redlines, provide SOC 2 attestation and redacted evidence, confirm retention windows and log exports for audits.

Action items / next steps
1) I will share our SOC 2 attestation and a redacted evidence pack, plus a short pen test summary (we avoid sharing full reports without an NDA). (Marissa)
2) Rishi to follow up on commercial timeline & initial sizing for Dedicated capacity if needed. (Rishi)
3) Dev to confirm how audit logs can be exported (CSV/JSON), retention windows, and the process for providing event-level logs for compliance audits. (Dev Patel)
4) Acme to share any DPA redlines or procurement checklist so we can prioritize the items. (Alice/Maya)

Expected timeline: we suggested doing an evidence handoff by EOD tomorrow and aiming to have a DPA redline returned within 7 business days to hit Acme's procurement cadence.

Attachments: none in this message; I will attach the SOC2/pen-test summary and a sample audit-logs export in my next email.

Thanks again — will follow up shortly with the pack.

—

Thanks Marissa — that recap looks right to us. A couple quick clarifications:

- For audit logs we need at minimum: request timestamp, requester identity, resource accessed, action (create/read/update/delete), and full request/response IDs for correlation. Can you confirm those fields are available in the export?
- For the pen test summary, procurement will be satisfied with a high-level executive summary plus scope and remediation status; full report will require an NDA.
- DPA: I will upload our standard DPA redlines into the DocuSign link you share. Procurement is aiming to complete vendor legal review by 12 March.

One other ask: can we get a sample extract of logs (anonymized) so our security team can validate ingestion/parsing on our side?

If you can send the SOC2 attestation and the sample logs tomorrow that'd be great.

Best,
Alice
